narrative_shape: Done-evidence waits, then a commit. Early turns check Perth parity and start compare_disc. From turn 83 through 116 the tail is hold-for-notification on roundtrip and full-disc coord_scale. Distinct reads stay at 2 and there is no reread table. Turn 117 the coord_scale check PASSes (0 of 1,461,347 exceeding) and turns 118–120 clean scratch and commit. The length is the wait; the wait resolves.
